launch_process_now.status_basis: Recovered PID, ownership, fixed run, start ticks, and boot ID; old PID absence is historical only

run.limitation: Each file is sampled once; active-run counts may lag later writes. Historical failures do not prove the current process failed.

recovery_resource_accounting.limitation: Counts are a read-only snapshot. Failed and in-progress generation work use the 50-NFE bound, not invented exact work; withheld operation files make global accounting incomplete.

filtering.policy: Before confirmation binding: only whitelisted search/dev stage events and diagnostic traceback/error headers; unknown structured/plain lines are withheld.

log_tail.limitation: Only a bounded tail sampled once; not a complete log. Source-tail hash includes bytes withheld from returned text; it is not a whole-file hash.
